Arrangement of Tools and tackles to carry out the work. Dismantling the old damaged high-pressure valves and filter blocks. Recording existing distance between the flanges, new high-pressure valves and filter set assembly and simulation before fabrication. Welding, gas cutting, drilling flange holes, lifting, lowering, dismantling, fixing are covered with scope of work and contractor should arrange for the required equipments, lifting tools, tackles, ropes, spanners and safety gadgets and insurance for the labourers technicians deployed for the works.
